<a2ui>
// Initialize filter state
$/filterStatus = "all"

// Sample data
$/items = [
  {id: 1, title: "Design System Update", status: "in_progress", detail: "Refining component library and documentation"},
  {id: 2, title: "API Integration", status: "completed", detail: "Successfully connected payment gateway"},
  {id: 3, title: "Mobile Optimization", status: "pending", detail: "Awaiting design approval from stakeholders"},
  {id: 4, title: "Database Migration", status: "in_progress", detail: "Moving legacy data to new PostgreSQL instance"},
  {id: 5, title: "Security Audit", status: "pending", detail: "Scheduled for next quarter review cycle"},
  {id: 6, title: "User Authentication", status: "completed", detail: "OAuth 2.0 implementation now live"},
  {id: 7, title: "Performance Testing", status: "in_progress", detail: "Load testing with 10k concurrent users"},
  {id: 8, title: "Documentation Portal", status: "completed", detail: "Published comprehensive API reference guide"}
]

// Status filter control
statusFilter = segmented_control(
  options=[
    {label: "All", value: "all"},
    {label: "Pending", value: "pending"},
    {label: "In Progress", value: "in_progress"},
    {label: "Completed", value: "completed"}
  ],
  selected_value=$/filterStatus,
  name="statusFilter"
)

// Define status appearance mapping
getStatusAppearance(status) = 
  status == "completed" ? "success" :
  status == "in_progress" ? "inprogress" :
  "moved"

// Item template
itemTemplate = entity_list(items=[
  {
    name: $title,
    subtitle: $detail,
    status: lozenge(text=$status, appearance=getStatusAppearance($status)),
    icon: "📋"
  }
])

// Filtered items based on status
filteredItems = $/filterStatus == "all" 
  ? $/items
  : $/items.filter(item => item.status == $/filterStatus)

// Root layout
root = body(text="") + [
  heading("Items"),
  statusFilter,
  _template(filteredItems, itemTemplate)
]
</a2ui>
